public_context: Beaver County page links farmer emergency information and a Farmers Special Needs Card
operational_risk: farms, livestock owners, and food businesses may not be registered, current, reachable, or categorized by product/animal/water source
minimum_packet: current farmer/producer/special-needs registry with product/animal categories, contact method, geography, annual outreach, hash, owner, redaction review

public_context: farm guidance points to animal care needs in radiological emergencies
operational_risk: livestock may consume contaminated pasture/feed/water or lack shelter/protected feed during plume/ingestion decisions
minimum_packet: livestock protective-action annex: shelter/protected feed/water instructions, outreach proof, farm call-down, animal welfare support, exercise or tabletop result

public_context: Ohio REP procedures list milk sampling; Ready PA identifies contamination of food/livestock/water within up to 50 miles
operational_risk: milk can enter commerce before hold/release/sampling/lab decisions are executed
minimum_packet: milk hold-and-release procedure, dairy producer contact list, sample custody, lab capacity, disposition/reimbursement path, public message, exercise/CAP evidence

public_context: Ohio REP procedures list produce and leafy-vegetation sampling
operational_risk: fresh produce can be harvested, sold, donated, or consumed before field/lab decisions are made
minimum_packet: produce/leafy vegetation sampling trigger, field team roster, sample kit/instrument status, chain-of-custody, lab turnaround SLA, grower instructions, compensation interface

public_context: Ohio REP procedures list animal feed and grain sampling
operational_risk: feed/grain mixing can spread contamination and complicate interdiction/claims
minimum_packet: animal feed/grain separation and sampling packet with storage segregation, signage, chain-of-custody, producer message, disposal/release decision log

public_context: Ohio REP procedures list meat/meat products, poultry/poultry products, and egg sampling
operational_risk: slaughter, movement, egg sales, and poultry products may continue without interdiction authority or sample results
minimum_packet: meat/poultry/egg hold/sampling/release protocol with ODA/local authority roles, processor/distributor contacts, sample custody, enforcement path, claims path

public_context: Ohio REP procedures list honey sampling
operational_risk: honey and hive products may be overlooked because they are lower-volume but cross-border/distribution pathways remain
minimum_packet: honey/apiary sampling and producer notification packet with hive location aggregation, sample chain, advisory language, market hold/release decision

public_context: Ready PA identifies water contamination risk within up to 50 miles; Ohio procedures list private-water and water-lab methods
operational_risk: private wells, rain barrels, irrigation intakes, and public water advisories may not be mapped to farms or households
minimum_packet: private-water/irrigation control packet with source inventory, closure/isolation instructions, sampling/logistics, alternate water supply, lab method, public advisory and claims path

public_context: farmers/producers/processors/distributors are within ingestion pathway planning scope
operational_risk: food already in collection, processing, distribution, or donation streams may be mixed with uncontaminated product
minimum_packet: processor/distributor stop-ship/hold/release protocol with contact list, inventory segregation, sample results, enforcement/recall path, public message

public_context: generic cube already required benefit/replacement pathway but not site-local proof
operational_risk: farm households and producers may comply with interdiction but lack income replacement, animal feed replacement, disposal reimbursement, or claims access
minimum_packet: claims/reimbursement/benefit packet with owner, eligibility, disaster assistance/insurance interface, language access, documentation burden, appeal path, public-safe dashboard

public_context: Ohio plan lists agriculture and health sampling procedures but not local execution records
operational_risk: sample loss, mislabeling, lab backlog, or conflicting results can delay food/water decisions
minimum_packet: cross-agency sample custody packet: field team, instrument calibration, sample labels, courier, lab receipt, QA/QC, result posting, decision log

public_context: BVPS 10-mile EPZ crosses PA/OH/WV and 50-mile ingestion footprint crosses jurisdictions
operational_risk: advisories, holds, sampling, and claims may diverge across borders
minimum_packet: tri-state ingestion interface control document with PA/OH/WV agriculture/public-health owners, common products, sample labs, release criteria, JIC language, exercise/CAP

public_context: public AFN and farmer materials do not prove animal transport/shelter operations
operational_risk: people may refuse evacuation or return early if pets/livestock are unmanaged
minimum_packet: pet/service-animal/livestock continuity packet with CART/animal shelter roles, livestock shelter/feed-water advisories, owner messaging, claims/disposal path

operational_risk: messages can conflict or omit farmer/AFN/LEP variants during protective action changes
minimum_packet: message variant packet with resident/AFN/farmer/processor/KI/ingestion-pathway templates, translation/ASL/plain-language QA, rumor log, exercise evaluation
